entities.summary: Henry Powell, a notable figure in the history of Barbados, associated with European Contact and Early Claims (1625–1627). Preceded by Captain John Powell claims Barbados for England in 1625 and Henry Powell establishes first English settlement at Holetown in 1627. Their legacy influenced Early Settlement: Tobacco and Cotton.
